text:
Noah: Hi team, quick onboarding questions. My offer stated health coverage starts on my first day (Apr 6) but the portal shows 04/15. Also I tried to set up direct deposit and got an error "invalid routing number" even though I copied it from my check.
Tess (People Ops): Welcome Noah! For the benefits start date we usually push the carrier your hire date but sometimes carriers use the payroll effective date. Can you DM your employee ID and I'll kick off a carrier correction?
Noah: ID 6612. Sent.
OnboardBot: Automated: new-hire profile created for Noah (ID 6612). Pending benefits verification.
Renee (Payroll): Hey Noah  payroll here. For routing errors, double-check there are no spaces and that the routing number is for a US bank. Some mobile-captured checks have OCR mistakes. If you're sure, upload a photo or PDF of the voided check and I'll validate. Filename tip: `6612_noah_voidcheck.jpg`.
Noah: Uploaded as JPG per that name.
Renee (Payroll): Got it. I validated the routing; bank account verification pending micro-deposits. Expect two small deposits in 1-2 business days. We can also do account verification manually if you need faster.
Noah: Appreciate it. If the micro-deposits aren't visible, what's the manual fallback?
Renee (Payroll): You can provide an official bank statement PDF showing account and routing, or we can do an ACH verification call. Manual verifications are processed same-day once docs are attached and approved.
Noah: Great. Back to benefits: I also elected dental & vision during enrollment but the dental premium shows $0 in portal line item. That seems off.
Eli (Benefits): Hi Noah  Benefits. Sometimes the portal hides employee premiums when the carrier bill is employer-paid for a short promo period. I can confirm: carrier is set to bill Redwood for the first month as an onboarding credit. After that your payroll deduction will appear starting the second pay period. I confirmed your coverage effective date is now corrected to 04/06.
Noah: Awesome, thanks. One more: I had a relocation expense submitted by my recruiter last week. Do I need to resubmit anything or will payroll pick it up?
Tess (People Ops): If the recruiter submitted via the relocation tracker it goes into the payroll queue. But sometimes receipts miss the category tag. Can you share the original file name so we can verify?
Noah: It was named "Relocate_Reimburse_Mar28.pdf".
Renee (Payroll): I see a pending item but missing the GL code. Can you re-submit with expense category "Relocation-Allowance" and tag me in the comment field so I can push approval. Also we prefer filenames like `reimburse_2026-03-28_Noah.pdf` for faster matching.
Noah: Re-uploaded with the requested name and tagged you.
OnboardBot: Automated: reimbursement item received and routed to Payroll for approval.
Noah: Thanks everyone  that's cleared up most of it. Last tiny ask: where do I find the holiday schedule in the portal?
Tess (People Ops): Holidays are in People Ops > Company Calendar or under the Handbook link inside the portal. I'll drop the recurring calendar invite to your Redwood calendar now.
Noah: Perfect, appreciate the help and the warm welcome :wave:
